content: If a man has reported to you that a certain person speaks ill of you, do not make any defense, but say: 'He did not know the rest of my faults, else he would not have mentioned these alone.'
author: Epictetus
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

In Epictetus's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
